                       PARTIAL STIPULATION AND AGREEMENT

       COMES NOW, Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy Missouri Metro (“EMM” or the

“Company”), Staff (“Staff”) for the Missouri Public Service Commission (“Commission”),

(individually “Signatory” and collectively “Signatories”) and agree to a Partial Stipulation and

Agreement (“Agreement”) that resolves certain pending issues in this docket, as stated below.

       The Office of the Public Counsel (“OPC”), Renew Missouri, and Google LLC do not

oppose Commission approval of this Agreement. Their non-opposition is limited to the resolution

reflected herein and does not constitute affirmative support for any specific term or any issue.

       MECG does not oppose the agreement except that Brian Andrew’s life estimate

adjustments are preserved for hearing. This preserves issue 17 (A) in part for MECG at hearing. A

determination on that issue could impact the rates and the Staff revenue requirements in this

Agreement.

                              STIPULATION AND AGREEMENT

       1.      The Signatories agree to the following terms as set forth below in exchange for a

$46 million increase in Staff’s revenue requirement filed with the true-up rebuttal testimony with

consideration to the revenue requirement ordered by the Commission for issues not settled in this

Stipulation and Agreement :




                                                 1
                                               Revenues
